text: Levi Ackerman has over 100 confirmed Titan kills, more than any other soldier in Attack on Titan.
Luffy's birthday is May 5, which is also Children's Day in Japan.
One Piece has been serialised since 1997 and has passed 1,100 manga chapters.
Light Yagami's name is written with the kanji for 'moon', deliberately read as 'Light'.
Hajime Isayama based the Titans' unsettling look on a drunk customer at the internet café where he once worked.
Vinland Saga's Thorfinn is loosely based on Thorfinn Karlsefni, a real Icelandic explorer who reached North America.
Naruto's Ichiraku Ramen is based on a real ramen shop near the university Masashi Kishimoto attended in Fukuoka.
Demon Slayer: Mugen Train was the highest-grossing film in the world in 2020, beating every Hollywood release.
Frieren: Beyond Journey's End topped MyAnimeList's all-time ranking in 2024, dethroning Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood.
Goku's Super Saiyan hair is blond partly so Toriyama's assistant didn't have to ink it black in every panel.
Spirited Away is still the only hand-drawn, non-English-language film to win the Oscar for Best Animated Feature.
Aizen Sōsuke's glasses in Bleach were fake: a prop for his gentle-captain disguise.
Eren Yeager's surname 'Jäger' is German for 'hunter'.
GTA V has sold over 200 million copies, making it one of the best-selling games of all time.
Red Dead Redemption 2's script ran to roughly 2,000 pages with about 500,000 lines of dialogue.
God of War (2018) is presented as a single continuous camera shot with no cuts from start to finish.
Christopher Judge, the voice of Kratos, gave the longest acceptance speech in Game Awards history in 2022.
Elden Ring sold 12 million copies in its first three weeks on sale.
Minecraft has passed 300 million copies sold, the most of any video game ever.
The Witcher 3's card game Gwent became so popular it was released as its own standalone game.
Assassin's Creed started life as a Prince of Persia spin-off called 'Prince of Persia: Assassin'.
Larian says Baldur's Gate 3 has around 17,000 possible ending permutations.
Hideo Kojima has a cameo in Cyberpunk 2077 as a bar patron in the Konpeki Plaza.
Resident Evil 4 (2005) has been ported to more than a dozen platforms, from GameCube to VR headsets.
Counter-Strike began as a fan-made Half-Life mod before Valve hired its creators.
Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 won nine awards at The Game Awards 2025, the most in the show's history.
Parasite (2019) was the first non-English-language film ever to win the Oscar for Best Picture.
Heath Ledger kept a 'Joker diary' for weeks and designed much of the character's smeared makeup himself.
Game of Thrones' 'The Long Night' episode was filmed over 55 consecutive night shoots.
Jesse Pinkman was supposed to die in Breaking Bad's first season; Aaron Paul's performance changed the plan.
Money Heist was nearly cancelled after its original Spanish run before Netflix turned it into a global hit.
Peaky Blinders is named after a real Birmingham street gang from the 1890s.
Stranger Things' Demogorgon takes its name from a demon prince in Dungeons & Dragons.
Sacred Games (2018) was Netflix's very first Indian original series.
Scam 1992 briefly held a 9.5 rating on IMDb, ranking among the highest-rated series on the platform.
Roger Clark, the voice of Arthur Morgan, spent years in motion capture for Red Dead Redemption 2's 2,200 days of shooting.
Ezio Auditore is the only Assassin's Creed protagonist to lead three mainline games.
Leon S. Kennedy's first day as a Raccoon City police officer was the day of the outbreak.
Kratos' tattoos were blue in early builds of God of War before the team switched them to red.
Guts' Dragon Slayer in Berserk is famously described as 'too big to be called a sword'.
Geralt's white hair and cat-like eyes are side effects of the Trial of the Grasses mutations.
Itachi Uchiha became an Anbu captain at 13 and died at just 21.
Johan Liebert is ranked among anime's greatest villains despite appearing in only a fraction of Monster's 74 episodes.
Thorfinn spends almost all of Vinland Saga's second season refusing to fight, a deliberate choice by the author.
